content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIHR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICMR-NIHR Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICMR-NIHR Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Program Coordinator and 3 for Research Associate.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Program Coordinator: First Class Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Nutrition with 3 years experience OR PhD in relevant subject OR Second Class Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Nutrition with PhD and 3 years experience. Research Associate: Postgraduate Degree in Public Health/Nutrition from a recognized institution with 1 year of experience.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable as per rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen etc. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Program Coordinator: Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month Research Associate: Rs. 40,000/- + HRA per month

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview / Written Test Document Verification Merit List

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICMR-NIHR recruitment is scheduled to be held on 16th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Program Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Program Coordinator post. In total, ICMR-NIHR is recruiting for 4 posts, including 3 Research Associate positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Program Coordinator role?
faq.answer: For the Program Coordinator position, candidates need a First Class Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Nutrition with 3 years of experience, a PhD in a relevant subject, or a Second Class Post Graduate Degree with a PhD and 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Program Coordinator and Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Program Coordinator and Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: The Program Coordinator will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month, while Research Associates will be paid Rs. 40,000/- + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these ICMR-NIHR jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to appear directly for the interview at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for ICMR-NIHR Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. The exact venue address will be detailed in the official notification PDF.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview / Written Test, followed by Document Verification, and finally, a Merit List will be prepared.
